messages:
marta: I've put together the relnotes for the July doc push. Main items: Embeddings streaming examples updated, Dedicated autoscale blurb, and a short note about anchor normalization. PR #3422 is ready for review — need snippet checks (Python, JS) and a quick link sweep. ping @ben @sai :wave:
ben: Skimming the JS snippet now. Small change: migrate `.then()` streaming to async iterator and rename `client` var to `rwClient` to match examples. Will push a commit.
sai: Running the anchor smoke locally. The publisher is dropping query fragments on anchors (e.g., `#config?tab=advanced` -> `#config`). Filed docs#1263. Short-term I can add a mapping table in the publish script to preserve known fragments.
toni: On Python snippet: shippable but uses `Client()` — we standardized on `RedwoodClient()` in the new SDK. I'll open a 1-line replacement and add compatibility note: "Old callers using Client() should migrate to RedwoodClient()."
docs-bot: Staging deploy scheduled: 2024-08-05T01:00Z. Blockers: UX signoff, screenshot for autoscale chart, anchor whitelist. CI status: passing, 1 flaky link check.
marta: For the Known Issues section, product requested a neutral sentence about webhook retries. Proposed: "During retry storms, duplicate webhook deliveries may be observable; we recommend idempotent handlers keyed by idempotency_key." Keep it advisory.
ben: tiny wording nit: prefer "idempotent processing (use idempotency_key)". I'll update PR text.
sai: I pushed a minimal publish-script patch to whitelist fragments for `/guides` and `/changelog` anchors — PR docs#1264. Added unit tests.
toni: Pushed Python snippet fix: ```diff
- from redwood import Client
- client = Client(api_key)
+ from redwood import RedwoodClient
+ client = RedwoodClient(api_key=api_key)
```
toni: Also added a short compatibility note right above the snippet.
marta: Great. Plan: resolve remaining UX feedback, run `scripts/check-anchors.sh staging` after deploy, and merge when docs-bot shows green. If anchors still fail in prod, we'll append an "anchor compatibility" note at the top of the relnote and follow-up with a rollback of the page only.
docs-bot: Reminder: release checklist incomplete  missing: screenshots (1), localization flags, and smoke-test URL report.
ben: I'll run anchor smoke test after staging and post results. If any anchors 404, I'll prepare redirects.
sai: One follow-up: the embeddings streaming example includes a buffer-size tip for Go, but we need to ensure it's labeled temporary. Added a one-liner in Known Issues.
marta: Perfect — thanks all. Merge plan stands after smoke test and UX signoff. :rocket:
